name: KeepOut
what_it_does: refuses structural edits to the regions marked [LOCK] in engine/ and to the guards the memory invariants depend on. tests/test_invariants_locked.py runs it
why_vendored: it used to be read from a sibling checkout named by an absolute path in shell.nix, so on any other machine the guard was silently absent and the lock test skipped. The invariant it protects is the load-bearing claim of this project, so it travels with the repository

upstream.commit_subject: style: Add iconic KeepOut ASCII Art banner to CLI and README.md

licence.name: Apache License 2.0
licence.was: NOT DECLARED until 2026-10-11. The upstream repository carried no LICENSE file, so nothing granted anything to anyone receiving this bundle, public repository or not
licence.why_this_one: Apache-2.0 states its patent grant explicitly, and scopes it to claims necessarily infringed by this software's own contribution. A licence silent on patents sitting beside a project with a patent application in flight invites an argument about implied grants; this one says plainly what is granted and what is not. KeepOut locks regions of a syntax tree, which is not the subject matter of that application, so the grant does not reach it. Permissive, so bundling it inside this repository propagates no obligation, and it disclaims warranty, which a bundle handed to someone else needs
licence.not_legal_advice: chosen on the reasoning above, not by a lawyer. Whoever handles the patent application should be told the SCOPE, not the name: a tool that locks regions of a syntax tree has been published under Apache-2.0, and that licence's patent grant is limited to claims necessarily infringed by that tool itself. Saying only "Apache-2.0" makes the filing side start by establishing the scope.
licence.upstream_still_unlicensed: this LICENSE covers the vendored copy here, which is unpublished. Adding one to the public upstream repository is itself an act of publication and cannot be undone, so it waits until the patent position is settled

divergence: tests/test_invariants_locked.py hashes these files and fails if the vendored copy changed without this manifest changing with it
